title: ochnella integrifolia
intro: Ochnella integrifolia, commonly known as the Ochna integrifolia, is a plant species in the family Ochnaceae, native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ochnella integrifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
